policies.meaning: The single base/default form represented by the canonical National Dex row.
A visual variation whose gameplay identity is unchanged or can be reconstructed from existing persistent data.
policies.requirement: The visual form must be deterministically recoverable; otherwise classify it as persistent_separate.

policies.meaning: A non-canonical form that changes persistent gameplay identity, such as form-dependent stats, typing, abilities, learnsets, or evolution behavior.
policies.storage_status: requires a separately versioned save/storage design before runtime use

policies.meaning: A battle-only transformation that reverts after battle and does not change the stored party/box species.

invariants: National Dex 1-898 contains only canonical base species rows.
Each canonical National Dex row has exactly one canonical form.
Alternate forms never consume a National Dex number or a species internal ID.
Persistent form differences use a separate stable form_key, not a new species ID.
Temporary battle forms never overwrite the persistent species identity.
Every source form reference must be classified before it is imported into runtime tables.
